# Pages Requirements Checklist: Website Docs GitHub Pages Publishing

**Purpose**: Validate quality of publishing, route/asset compatibility, and maintainer-operations requirements before implementation/review.
**Created**: 2026-02-21
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are deployment-trigger requirements defined for both automatic default-branch publishes and manual reruns? [Completeness, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements explicit about the deployable artifact type and where it is produced from source content? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK003 Are repository-path hosting requirements defined for both route links and static asset references? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK004 Are maintainer-observable diagnostics requirements defined for all failure classes identified in edge cases? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are one-time enablement requirements and ongoing publish operation requirements both documented as separate requirement concerns? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Spec §User Story 3]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is “easily published” clarified with objective maintainer outcomes rather than subjective wording? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK007 Is “latest content revision” defined precisely enough to avoid ambiguity about which commit is expected to be public? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK008 Are “failure reasons” requirements specific about expected diagnostic granularity (step/stage vs generic failure)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK009 Are “repository-native automation logs” requirements clear on required observability source and reviewer access assumptions? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK010 Is “no manual artifact handling” requirement scoped clearly to exclude ambiguity around generated outputs in version control? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do requirements for static hosting compatibility align between functional requirements and plan constraints without conflict? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK012 Do route/asset compatibility requirements align with success metrics for primary pages and missing-asset thresholds? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Do maintainer workflow requirements align with assumptions about repository admin access and dependency constraints? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the non-breaking classification for issue contract behavior consistent across spec and plan constitution checks? [Consistency, Spec §Issue Document Contract, Plan §Constitution Check]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Are success criteria measurable with explicit thresholds and time bounds rather than qualitative adjectives? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK016 Can each functional requirement be traced to at least one acceptance scenario or measurable success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001..FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are acceptance scenarios written with unambiguous preconditions and outcomes suitable for independent review? [Measurability, Spec §User Story 1-3]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK018 Are primary scenarios complete for publish trigger, deployment execution, and public reachability outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK019 Are alternate scenarios defined for manual rerun/recovery when automatic publish does not complete successfully? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Are exception-flow requirements complete for permissions failure and Pages-not-enabled conditions? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are recovery expectations defined after failure (e.g., retry path, operator handoff, expected final state)? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 Are concurrent-update requirements sufficiently defined to avoid ambiguity about deterministic “latest published state”? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined for direct deep-link page access under repository-scoped URLs, not only nav-path access? [Edge Case, Spec §User Story 2, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements defined for behavior when a subset of assets is missing while HTML routes remain reachable? [Edge Case, Spec §SC-003, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 Are deployment duration expectations and diagnostic-time expectations specified as enforceable NFR constraints? [Non-Functional, Plan §Technical Context, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Are reliability expectations for publish availability specified for repeated default-branch updates over time? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-001, Gap]
- [ ] CHK027 Are security/permission requirements for deployment identity and minimal privileges explicitly documented? [Non-Functional, Spec §Dependencies, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK028 Are assumptions about repository ownership, Pages hosting target, and source directory stability validated as current and non-conflicting? [Dependencies, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK029 Are external dependencies (GitHub Pages configuration and workflow permissions) expressed as verifiable preconditions? [Dependencies, Spec §Dependencies]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts
